notes.title: Version 8.247 - 8.248
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Tribal Wars Community,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38872948/49c886af96c357cef074075fc1ba44c075ba4c02.png[/img]

our next update will be released on Monday and Tuesday, 2021-06-28 and 2021-06-29, and with it, we'll be releasing a couple of bug fixes!

Because last week there was only one bug that was shipped out, we wanted to wait until there is more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38872948/372960c51d8efcdf8d946c605771c9614363d237.png[/img]

This week, we have five bug fixes for you! 

[list]
[*] A problem on Beta concerning mass-scavenging was fixed.
[*] A problem on Beta regarding missing transport records was fixed. 
[*] A problem with creating a new account on the browser interface which resulted in an error code was fixed.
[*] A problem with creating a new account on iOS and Android which resulted in an error code was fixed.
[*] A problem with dynamic group listing showing the wrong text in the graphical overview was fixed. 
[/list]
Right now, our developers are still working hard on our Attack Planner redesign that will be released next month and a new event that will come this year! More on that will soon be available via the usual channels! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38872948/3766bc94e4d1cd49428c58aaadd0efea29146bc0.png[/img]

And this concludes this weeks' Changelog! Do you have any Feedback? Feel free to write a comment! 

Kind regards,

Your Tribal Wars Team

notes.title: Mac OS version now available
notes.notes: We're happy to announce that Tribal Wars is now also available on Mac OS X for Steam!
